nodes.name: power_3v3
nodes.description: AMS1117-3.3 LDO steps VIN_5V down to VCC_3V3 (CE tied to VIN for always‑on). Provides the 3.3 V supply for MCU, CAN controller and transceiver. Decoupling caps are placed locally. This module is the sole VCC_3V3 provider.
5V to 3.3V LDO

nodes.name: mcu
nodes.description: STM32F103 MCU operating from VCC_3V3. Acts as SPI master for the MCP2515 controller (SPI_SCK, SPI_MOSI, SPI_MISO, SPI_CS). Receives controller interrupt (CAN_INT). All digital logic runs at 3.3 V. BOOT0 is pulled low for flash boot (handled in passive design).
ARM Cortex-M3 MCU

nodes.name: can_controller
nodes.description: MCP2515 standalone CAN controller powered by VCC_3V3. Uses external 8 MHz crystal (OSC1/OSC2). Operates as SPI slave (SPI_SCK, SPI_MOSI, SPI_MISO, SPI_CS). Provides CAN bus TX (TXCAN) and RX (RXCAN) signals to the transceiver and raises INT to the MCU on message events.
SPI CAN controller

nodes.name: can_transceiver
nodes.description: SN65HVD230 3.3 V CAN transceiver powered by VCC_3V3. Receives controller driver data on D (TXCAN) and drives the differential bus lines CANH/CANL. Returns received bus data on R (RXCAN) to the controller. RS and VREF pins are internally biased for normal operation.
3.3V CAN transceiver

nodes.name: RS
nodes.description: Slew rate control. GND=high speed, 10K-100K to GND=slope control, VCC=standby.
